substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Plan-author operator pre-flight verification (per `math-scripts.md §"Plan-

    rho_R(s=3) = M_R(s=3)/M_BARE(s=3) is a RATIO of Hochschild-pairing-image

    Definition 1: M_R(s=3) = Σ_k m_k · w_R(λ_k²; s=3) · λ_k^{-6}
                  (Hochschild-pairing image at substrate-distance-1 pole s=3
                   on the FINITE spectral triple (A_K, H_K, D_K(τ_fold)),

                  per Connes 1994 §VI.3 + CM-1995 §III.4 simple-pole residue.
    Definition 2: w_R(λ²; s) = regulator multiplier:
                  - zeta:               w_R = 1 (bare Mellin)
                  - SDW (Seeley-DeWitt): w_R = 1 + Σ_n a_n(t)·t^n at small-t Casimir cutoff

                  - Mellin:             w_R = 1 (equivalent to zeta on positive-Casimir
                                            spectrum per `_spectral_action_regulators.py`
                                            docstring lines 17-18)
                  - lattice:            w_R = θ(λ² ≤ Λ_lat²) (sharp cutoff)
    Definition 3: rho_R(s=3) = M_R(s=3) / M_BARE(s=3)
                  with M_BARE = M_zeta(s=3) the bare-spectrum baseline.
    Definition 4: atlas_spread = (max_R rho_R - min_R rho_R) / mean_R rho_R
                  per `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Per-Bulletin-per-pole
                  Level-1 wall classification"` FI/RD/MIXED bands.

    Substitute: For the SDW class evaluated at L_max=10 STRICT_F4 via the
                f_4_prefactor_sdw DERIVATIVE relation (canonical_constants.py:159-273):
                rho_SDW(s=3) ≡ R_universal_HP1_strict_F4 = 1.030902 (canonical pin).

                = |1.030902 - 1.0100907902| / 1.020496 = 2.040e-2
                ≈ 2.04% (>> 1e-2 RD floor; >> 1e-3 FI ceiling).

    Canonical form (substitution chain Step 4): the 5-atlas spread INCLUDES the

                LEAST 2.04% by construction, and the additional 3 regulators
                (Mellin = zeta numerically; lattice; SDW vs zeta differ by

                cannot CONTRACT it below 2.04%.

    Direction (Step 5): atlas_spread ≥ 2.04e-2 = 2.04% > 1e-2 RD floor.

                pre-registered PASS-band (atlas_spread < 1e-3 FI) is structurally
                unreachable given the SDW canonical pin and the L_max=12 FULL-CC
                measurement already on record. The 3-band classifier therefore
                pre-registers a FAIL OR INFO outcome (FAIL iff atlas_spread > 1e-2;
                INFO iff 1e-3 ≤ atlas_spread ≤ 1e-2 — which is unreachable here
                by the same lower bound).

    Conclusion: this gate is PRE-REGISTERED as a FAIL-WITH-DIAGNOSTIC: the
                expected verdict is FAIL with diagnostic data being the per-class
                rho_R values, atlas spread numerical value, and the dual-canonical
                STRUCTURAL-ORTHOGONAL-COMPANION proposal for §VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ

                a result — it closes the SCHEMATIC-vs-FULL ambiguity at
                substrate-distance-1 pole s=3 on the §VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ Level-3
                anchor with a numerical Level-1 RD classification.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: |
  Either test (a) PASS (Z_factor matches a substrate-IS rational candidate at
  1e-2; one layer IS the substrate-IS Z-renormalization of the other) OR test
  (b) PASS (R_third matches exactly ONE prior layer at 1e-2; that layer IS
  the canonical substrate-IS evaluation, the other is its methodology-floor
  F-image). PASS adjudicates which layer of the W3 T1.8 + W9 T2.31 PARALLEL
  pair IS the canonical substrate-IS evaluation at the substrate-distance-2
  pole subleading-residue under the (c)∘(d) compositional restriction. The
  adjudicated canonical layer becomes the registry-canonical for §VII.AU
  CF-37 entry; the non-canonical layer is recorded as a STRUCTURAL-ORTHOGONAL
  -COMPANION F-image per `registry-landing.md §"Operator-Projection Reading-A
  Naming Hygiene"`. Becomes K=1 calibration corpus instance for the
  `substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(ii.A)` atlas-row vs cache-moment
  orthogonality K-counter analog at the CF-37 axis.

FAIL_meaning: |
  Both test (a) AND test (b) FAIL — Z_factor does NOT match any substrate-IS
  rational candidate AND R_third matches neither R_ansatz nor R_CM_full within
  1e-2. Implies BOTH layers are F-images of a DEEPER substrate-IS canonical
  at a third evaluation convention not yet enumerated (per S91 W9-7 CF-W9-7-3
  substitution-chain Step 5 case (b)). Triggers S92 W2+ adversarial workshop
  dispatch (volovik + vdd; mack-cosmic-bridge sole-writer for §VII.AU CF-37
  closure) to identify the deeper canonical. Substrate-physics finding: the
  (c)∘(d) compositional secondary corridor at substrate-distance-2 pole s=4
  admits AT LEAST 3 distinct substrate-IS evaluation conventions in the
  algebra-INVARIANT Cell I family; the framework's INTRA-Corner-I sub-axis
  taxonomy requires extension. K=1 calibration corpus instance for a NEW
  3-layer CF-37 axis K-counter (beyond the §(ii.A) 2-layer atlas-row vs
  cache-moment binary).

INFO_meaning: |
  Partial match (one test PASSes; the other returns marginal-band 1e-2 ≤
  |Δ|/Δ ≤ 1e-1). Marginal adjudication — pins ONE layer as canonical with
  caveat; the other layer remains a candidate canonical pending higher-L_max
  evaluation at S93+ (L_max=14 extension cache `s87_spectrum_cache_L14_tau019.npz`
  available for L-stability test on R_third in particular). Routes to a S92
  W2+ refinement gate.

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Definition 1: Res_W(P)(L_max) = Wodzicki noncommutative residue on
                  pseudodifferential operator P over substrate algebra A_K
                  at finite L_max truncation, per Wodzicki 1984 unique-trace
                  theorem on Ψ⁻ᵈ pseudodifferential ideal on the spectral
                  triple (A_K, H_K, D_K).
                  Source: substrate-IS Wodzicki residue at finite L_max
                  evaluable via CM-1995 §III.4 simple-pole residue formula
                  on the FINITE spectral triple (per `_cm_1995_residue_formula.py`
                  module).
    Definition 2: HKR(L_max) = substrate-IS Hochschild-pairing-image at
                  substrate-distance-1 pole s=3 on (A_K, H_K, D_K) at finite
                  L_max truncation per Hochschild-Kostant-Rosenberg theorem
                  bridging discrete Hochschild cohomology to continuum
                  de Rham-image.
                  Source: substrate-IS finite-L Hochschild pairing (the
                  rho_FULL(s=3, L_max) atlas member from §W1-1 / §W1-2).
    Definition 3: B_composite_Wodzicki(L_max) = Res_W(D_K^{-2s})|_{s=2}(L_max)
                  · HKR(L_max)
                  (composite F-image with Wodzicki F-functor as multiplicative-
                  leading factor; HKR carries the substrate-distance-1
                  cohomology-class identity).
    Definition 4: canonical_anchor = (conditional on §W1-2 verdict)
                  - if §W1-2 PASSed: canonical_anchor = rho_FULL_CC_VII_AU_SAT(s=3)
                    at CLASS=FULL (substrate-natural canonical at CLASS=FULL).
                  - if §W1-2 FAILed OR not-landed: canonical_anchor = SCHEMATIC
                    F-image at CLASS=SCHEMATIC (two-pin protocol per
                    canonical_constants.py:2189-2249); convention tag carries
                    `-SCHEMATIC` suffix per `substrate-first-canonical-
                    sourcing.md §(iv)`.
    Definition 5: Δ_emp_Wodzicki(L_max) = |B_composite_Wodzicki(L_max) -
                  canonical_anchor| / |canonical_anchor|
    Definition 6: α_composite_Wodzicki, C_emp_Wodzicki from log-log fit
                  Δ_emp_Wodzicki(L) = C_emp · L^{-α_composite_Wodzicki}
                  over L_max ∈ {8, 10, 12} (3 points, 2 degrees of freedom).

    Substitute (substrate-IS chain-rule on convergence exponents per S91
                W9-8 Step 3): the composite envelope satisfies
                |B_composite_Wodzicki(L) - B_composite_Wodzicki(∞)| ≤
                |Res_W'| · |HKR(L) - HKR(∞)| + O(L^{-2·α_HKR}) +
                |HKR(∞)| · |Res_W(L) - Res_W(∞)| + O(L^{-2·α_Wodzicki}).
                For multiplicative-leading composition (orthogonal envelopes)
                α_composite_Wodzicki ≥ min(α_Wodzicki, α_HKR).

    Simplify (Step 4): with α_Wodzicki = 3 (Connes 1995 §III subleading-
                correction order at d=4) and α_HKR = 3 (per cross-pillar-
                bridge-anatomy.md d=4 Level-2 envelope), worst-case
                α_composite_Wodzicki ≥ min(3, 3) = 3. The MS ∘ HKR composite
                FAILed at α_composite_MS = -1.518765 NEGATIVE because α_MS =
                2 ≠ α_Wodzicki = 3 introduced the SR-LO truncation degradation;
                replacing MS with Wodzicki (which carries α_Wodzicki = 3
                matching α_HKR = 3) eliminates the SR-LO truncation
                degradation.

    Canonical form (Step 5): α_composite_Wodzicki = 3 expected if Wodzicki
                F-functor at substrate-distance-1 pole s=3 carries the
                substrate-IS α=3 convergence rate per Connes 1995 §III.
                The empirical L_max ∈ {8, 10, 12} log-log regression resolves
                the actual value.

    Direction (Step 6): PASS direction α_composite_Wodzicki ≥ 3 is the
                substrate-natural expected outcome; FAIL direction
                α_composite_Wodzicki < 2 would mean Wodzicki ∘ HKR composition
                breaks for a non-MS-truncation reason (a structurally
                informative substrate-physics finding).

    Conclusion: PASS pre-registered as the substrate-natural prediction (the
                composite bridge map Wodzicki ∘ HKR recovers the α_HKR = 3
                envelope by eliminating the MS SR-LO truncation that caused
                the S91 W9-8 FAIL). FAIL would inform the constraint surface

                at CF-W9-9-1 is the related sister-gate).

  CLASS=SCHEMATIC fallback). The Wodzicki ∘ HKR composite bridge map RECOVERS
  the α_HKR = 3 envelope by eliminating the Mukhanov-Sasaki SR-LO α_MS = 2
  truncation degradation that caused the S91 W9-8 anti-convergence. Composite
  envelope is at least as tight as HKR alone at d=4. This is the substrate-

  composite bridge map ALSO degrades the envelope (beyond what HKR alone

  pathway (per S91 W9-8 carry-forward CF-W9-8-1 Field 11 alternative-bridge
  candidate list).

INFO_meaning: |
  2.0 ≤ α_composite_Wodzicki < 3.0 OR (α ≥ 3.0 AND 1.0 < C_emp_Wodzicki ≤ 5.0).
  Wodzicki ∘ HKR composite bridge map PARTIALLY RECOVERS the envelope —

  Substrate-physics finding: Wodzicki F-functor IS structurally tighter than

**Joint downstream effect on W2**: at minimum, §W1-1 FAIL or INFO triggers the §VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ STRUCTURAL-ORTHOGONAL-COMPANION dual-canonical landing in W2; §W1-2 PASS triggers the §VII.AU.OP-PROJ canonical-write-order Step 2 promotion to CLASS=FULL; §W1-4 PASS opens the Wodzicki ∘ HKR composite recovery pathway feeding W2 §VII.BA. Any subset of {PASS, FAIL, INFO} across the 4 W1 gates routes to a distinct combinatorial sub-state of W2 dispatch; the W2 plan-author must inspect W1 verdicts at W2 plan-freeze and pin the conditional dispatch state explicitly.
